mentions.name: SimuPort
mentions.description: This platform makes advanced multiphysics simulations and optimizations accessible through a simple web interface and AI chat agents, lowering the barrier to running and iterating on complex simulations such as airflow optimization and thermal-structural analysis.
mentions.problem: Complex multiphysics simulations have a high barrier to entry, making them hard to run and iterate on.
mentions.audience: Practitioners who need engineering simulations in practice, such as optimizing airflow in devices or analyzing thermal-structural interactions in prototypes, including users of tools like Ansys, OpenFOAM, COMSOL, and SimScale.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Making advanced multiphysics simulations and optimizations accessible through a simple web interface and AI chat agents. I’m building SimuPort (https://simuport.com
) to lower the barrier to running and iterating on complex simulations.
